title: Diagram document
description: A diagram authored as an intermediate representation. scripts/diagram_ir.py is the authoritative implementation of this contract; this file documents it for editors and general JSON Schema tools. tests/test_contract.py fails if the two disagree, so neither can drift.

kind.description: One diagram answers one question. The kind picks the layout and the vocabulary.

subtitle.description: One or two sentences of context. A good subtitle states what the diagram asserts, so a reader can tell when it has gone stale.

orientation.description: Not used by the sequence kind, which is always top to bottom.

legend.description: Extra legend entries. Loop, async and boundary entries are derived automatically.

groups.description: Boundaries. Use for trust, network or ownership boundaries, not for teams or directories. Laid out as swimlanes, so a node may belong to at most one group.

nodes.description: Required for every kind except sequence.

edges.description: Direction is meaning: an edge points the way a request or a record travels.

participants.description: Required for the sequence kind. Lifelines, left to right.

messages.description: Required for the sequence kind. Rendered in order, numbered.

shape.description: box service, round start or end state, cylinder datastore, queue queue or topic, cloud managed or third-party service, actor a person, decision a branch.

style.description: Edges that close a cycle default to dashed.

note.description: Say something the label cannot: a constraint, a guarantee, a gotcha.

tech.description: The concrete technology, shown small and monospaced.

accent.description: Use once per diagram, on the thing the diagram exists to show.
